title: Plume affiliate lands broker-dealer license to bring real U.S. assets onchain
content: Kimber Digital Securities secured SEC and Finra approvals, a regulatory milestone paving the way for the delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products directly to self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications in the U.S.
summary: Kimber Digital Securities, an affiliate of Plume, has secured crucial SEC and Finra approvals to operate as a broker-dealer in the U.S. This regulatory milestone will enable the direct delivery of legally binding claims, dividends, and yield-bearing products onto blockchain via self-custodial wallets and stablecoin applications, significantly advancing the tokenization of real-world assets.

title: Crypto is now teamed up with U.S. government in two legal battles over perps

title: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet moved $4.6 million and dodged a scam set up in minutes
content: Bots spotted a wallet from Ethereum’s 2015 launch the moment it stirred and planted lookalike addresses in its history, but the owner sent the money to the right place anyway.
summary: An 11-year-old Ethereum wallet that had been dormant since 2015 recently moved $4.6 million. Immediately upon activation, bots attempted a sophisticated scam by planting lookalike addresses in its transaction history. Despite this rapid attack, the wallet owner successfully transferred the funds to the correct destination, thus avoiding the scam.

title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion in six weeks, plans to sell more

summary: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion over six weeks to pay off all its bitcoin-backed loans. The company plans to sell additional coins to fund investments in AI datacenters. title: XRP Ledger maps out quantum-proof accounts, with no extra fees for users

title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out

title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
content: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder 117,000 NEAR, worth about $430,000, from the $6.3 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says.

title: Hands-on with Ring’s new AI drone camera for your home
content:
Ring’s new Drone Cam is a flying indoor security camera.
